project_description.value: Build-out of an existing warehouse area at Enthalpy Analytics Labs to become additional lab and admin spaces. BFA scope: mechanical and electrical design only. Mechanical scope includes 5 split system heat pumps, controls, and a dedicated make-up air split system to offset 1,250 CFM exhausted by lab hoods (provided by others). Electrical scope includes power and lighting design for the new split systems, admin, and lab spaces.
project_description.quote: This project includes the build-out of an existing warehouse area of the Enthalpy Analytics Labs in Richmond, Va. The current warehouse shall become additional lab and admin spaces.

mechanical_scope_detail.value: 5 split system heat pumps with controls for conditioning labs and admin spaces; 1 dedicated make-up air split system to supply 1,250 CFM to offset lab hood exhaust and maintain positive building pressurization.
mechanical_scope_detail.quote: Provide 5 split system heat pumps and controls to condition the labs and admin spaces. Also, a dedicated make-up air split system shall be designed to make-up 1250 cfm exhausted by lab hoods which shall be provided by others. Intent of the make-up air unit is to maintain positive building pressurization when lab hoods are operating.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL LEGEND AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Legend/abbreviations/general-notes sheet for the mechanical set. Symbols defined: condensate drain, supply and return duct sections, thermostat/sensor marks, manual balancing damper, fire/smoke damper, motorized control damper, grille/diffuser mark, radius elbow, AHU mark, heat pump mark referencing schedule sheet M-501, make-up air unit (MAHU) referencing schedule sheet M-501. 16 general notes covering: sole-source submission requirement; volume dampers; UFC/ANSI drawing reference standard; TAB requirements; code compliance (ASHRAE 55, 90.1, 62.1, ADAAG, OSHA, municipal, state, federal); GC coordination with mechanical; equipment coordination for conflicts; cut openings; no equipment above electrical panels; duct sizing note (diagrammatic on plans, 24" min clearance for access); all duct transitions radius elbows or splitter vanes; no equipment over electrical service; access doors and panels requirement; servicing clearances; thermostat/sensor placement (48" AFF minimum). Sheet is 'M-001 of XX' — indicates additional mechanical sheets (floor plan, schedule M-501) exist but were not included in the submitted PDF. Drawing date: 10/20/2021. Firm: Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc., Norfolk VA.

sheets.title: ELECTRICAL LEGEND AND ABBREVIATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Legend/abbreviations/general-notes sheet for the electrical set. Electrical symbol legend includes: lighting fixtures (IFD emergency/exit, LED pendant low-bay, occupancy/dimming sensors for ceiling mount PIR/ultrasonic dual-tech at 48" AFF), receptacles (single 20A 120V at 48" AFF, duplex 20A 120V at 18" AFF in standard and emergency power variants, quadruplex 20A 120V at 16" AFF, 230V NEMA 6-15R for emergency power, exterior GFCI duplex weather-proof at 18" ABR), equipment connection symbol, junction box ceiling-mount, power pole, disconnect switch (600V NEMA 3R enclosure, 3-pole, 60A-switch rating, 40A fuse), dry-type transformer, panelboards (208Y/120V and 480Y/277V shown), branch circuit concealed in ceiling. Two general notes: (1) provide corrected panelboard schedule for existing panel(s) supporting this project; (2) provide typical arc flash hazard warning labels on panelboards per NEC 2020, referencing 'ARC WARNING AB71' detail. Large ARC FLASH WARNING label graphic on sheet referencing NFPA 70E — indicates 480V system present. Sheet 'E-001 of XX' — additional electrical sheets (plans, panelboard schedules, L-601 lighting fixture schedule) exist but were not in this PDF. Drawing date shown on sheet: 10/20/2021; PDF filename: 'ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS 11-12-21.pdf' suggesting a possible 11/12/2021 revision issue. Firm: Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc.
